leadText: A character of the day (often abbreviated as a COD or CotD, and also referred to as character of the week; Japanese: ゲストキャラ lit. guest character) is an unofficial term referring to a character in the Pokémon animated series who appears in only one episode and is often, but not always, relatively unimportant to the series. While they are usually a human, this label may also be given to a . Note that Gym Leaders, Frontier Brains, Elite Four members, or other characters that originate from the games (such as Bill) are not considered as characters of the day, even if they had appeared in one episode only.
